recognize_zh: 這是部分核型圖（非型態圖）：左為正常 5 號與長臂缺失的 del(5)(q11q33)，右為正常 7 號與 del(7)(q11q36)，箭頭指出短縮的衍生染色體；5q 與 7q 同時缺失屬於 MDS 的不良預後核型。
features: Partial G-banded karyogram of chromosome pairs 5 and 7
Arrow on chromosome 5 highlights a markedly shortened long arm consistent with del(5)(q11q33)
Arrow on chromosome 7 highlights loss of most of the long arm consistent with del(7)(q11q36)
Labels below state del(5)(q11q33) and del(7)(q11q36)
Image resolution is low; fine band-level detail cannot be assessed independently
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic cytogenetic figure showing a partial G-banded karyogram. For chromosome 5, the normal homolog is paired with a derivative chromosome showing loss of most of the long arm, labeled del(5)(q11q33); for chromosome 7, the normal homolog is paired with a derivative showing loss of the long arm, labeled del(7)(q11q36). The co-occurrence of del(5q) with del(7q) excludes the category of MDS with isolated del(5q) and places the karyotype in a poor-risk group. The findings support a clonal myelodysplastic syndrome in the stated context of multilineage dysplasia.
